# Degradation Digest — 2026-05-12

**Report Time:** 2026-05-12T12:01:05Z  
**Total Events:** 100  
**Unique Features:** 9  
**Time Window:** ~14 hours (04:17 UTC → 18:38 UTC)

---

## CRITICAL — Better-SQLite3 Version Mismatch

**Impact:** 39 events across 3 features (SemanticMemory, FeatureRegistry, iMessage, sqlite-runtime)  
**Status:** Recurring, no recovery  
**Root Cause:** Native module built for Node.js v25.x (MODULE_VERSION 127) but runtime is v25.6.1 expecting MODULE_VERSION 141

```
Error: The module '[...]/better_sqlite3.node' was compiled against a different Node.js version
using NODE_MODULE_VERSION 127. This version of Node.js requires NODE_MODULE_VERSION 141.
```

**Affected Features:**
- `SemanticMemory` (13 occurrences) — Knowledge graph unavailable; migration & semantic search disabled
- `FeatureRegistry` (13 occurrences) — Feature state not persisted; defaults to in-memory definitions only
- `iMessage` (12 occurrences) — iMessage messaging adapter completely unavailable
- `sqlite-runtime-broken` (13 occurrences) — Layer 2 (durable queue) disabled; pending-relay queue unavailable

**Fix:**
```bash
cd /Users/justin/Documents/Projects/instar
npm rebuild better-sqlite3
instar restart
```

---

## HIGH — Git Pull Terminal Prompts Disabled

**Impact:** 12 events (recurring every ~10 min)  
**Status:** Blocking git-sync, attempting fallback  
**Root Cause:** `git pull --rebase --autostash` fails when terminal prompts are disabled (GitHub auth requires input)

```
fatal: could not read Username for 'https://github.com': terminal prompts disabled
```

**Fallback:** Auto-conflict resolution attempted but may fail silently  
**First Seen:** 2026-05-12T04:31:36Z  
**Last Seen:** 2026-05-12T16:31:54Z

**Mitigation:** SSH key or credential helper required for non-interactive git auth

---

## HIGH — TopicMemory Node Path ENOENT

**Impact:** 12 events (recurring every ~10 min)  
**Status:** Blocking TopicMemory init  
**Root Cause:** `spawnSync /opt/homebrew/Cellar/node/25.6.1/bin/node` returns ENOENT (file not found)

```
TopicMemory init failed: spawnSync /opt/homebrew/Cellar/node/25.6.1/bin/node ENOENT
```

**Fallback:** Sessions start without conversation summaries; search unavailable; context limited to last 20 raw JSONL messages

**First Seen:** 2026-05-12T04:32:09Z  
**Last Seen:** 2026-05-12T16:32:15Z

**Likely Cause:** Homebrew node symlink/installation issue; PATH environment variable mismatch

**Verification:**
```bash
ls -la /opt/homebrew/Cellar/node/25.6.1/bin/node
which node
node --version
```

---

## LOW (Self-Healing) — Input Recovery

**Impact:** 24 events across 2 features (StuckInputSentinel, SessionManager.verifyInjection)  
**Status:** All recovered automatically; no user intervention required  
**Pattern:** Bracketed paste + Enter race condition → automatic re-send

**Features:**
- `StuckInputSentinel.recover` (13 occurrences) — Persistent sentinel fires Enter after timeout
- `SessionManager.verifyInjection` (11 occurrences) — In-process verification re-sends Enter

---

## Summary

| Issue | Severity | Occurrences | Trend | Action |
|-------|----------|-------------|-------|--------|
| better-sqlite3 mismatch | Critical | 39 | Recurring | Rebuild native module |
| Git auth prompts disabled | High | 12 | Recurring | Configure SSH/credential helper |
| TopicMemory node ENOENT | High | 12 | Recurring | Verify Homebrew node path |
| Input recovery | Low | 24 | Self-healing | No action needed |

---

**Recommendation:** Fix better-sqlite3 first (blocking many features), then address git auth and node path issues.
